Package com.csse3200.game.cards.play

Class CardPlayService

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.cards.play.CardPlayService
public final class CardPlayService extends Object
Coordinates Team 5 card play with Team 7 energy state.

This class does not own player energy. It asks Team 7's EnergyComponent to spend the card cost, then resolves Team 5 card effects and moves the card from hand to discard.

  • Method Details

    • canPlay

      public boolean canPlay(String cardId)
      Read-only check for whether a card is currently playable.

      This is intended for UI previews. The authoritative play path remains playCard(java.lang.String), which calls Team 7's EnergyComponent.spendEnergy(int).

      Parameters:
      cardId - card ID to check
      Returns:
      true if the card is in hand and Team 7 says the player can afford it

    • canPlay

      public boolean canPlay(CardPlayRequest request)

      Parameters:
      request - card and selected target
      Returns:
      true only when the card, target, hand and energy checks currently pass

    • playCard

      public CardPlayResult playCard(String cardId)
      Attempts to play a card from the current hand.

      When successful, Team 7 energy is spent first, then Team 5 resolves effects, then the battle deck moves the card from hand to discard. When energy is insufficient, no card effects are resolved and the hand remains unchanged.

      Parameters:
      cardId - card ID to play
      Returns:
      structured play result with either resolved effects or a failure reason

    • playCard

      public CardPlayResult playCard(CardPlayRequest request)
      Unified Team 5 entry point for a card play attempt from Team 3/battle flow.

      Expected validation failures are returned as data. A failed result never spends energy or moves the card. A successful result spends energy exactly once, records the resolved effects, moves the card to the discard pile and includes immutable deck snapshots.

      Parameters:
      request - card ID and already selected target
      Returns:
      complete result for UI coordination and Team 1/Team 7 effect consumers
